## Problem statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature solves (e.g., unsupported drift pattern, new emitter target, middleware integration).

## Proposed solution
Describe the solution you'd like, including any CLI flags, Python APIs, or configuration options.

## Alternatives considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Zero-PII & Security considerations
Does this feature touch scalar payload values, LLM calls, or persistent storage? If so, how does it preserve the zero-PII boundary?
